text:
Evan: quick runtime follow-up from today's all-hands — a few roadmap clarifications we need for the doc: 

- Which microbatch sizes should product recommend for interactive chat vs bulk inference?
- How does KV cache isolation work for multi-tenant routes (any cross-tenant risk)?
- Who triggers kernel canaries and who can force an emergency revert?
- Minimal telemetry widgets we should point PMs to (one-liners ok).

Riya: Answers from runtime lead (short): 
- Microbatch defaults: chat routes => max_batch 8 (latency-first). Bulk/embeddings => 64 default, 128 for GPU-heavy throughput. We also support per-route overrides but infra access required today.
- KV cache: per-session pin for 2-5 minutes, then best-effort shared-prefix caching. No cross-tenant leakage — strong tenant isolation at keying layer. Cache is advisory; don't depend on it for correctness. Eviction = TTL(30m) + size-LRU.
- Canary & rollback: runtime eng schedules canaries. SRE is empowered to force immediate rollback on safety signals. Normal automated fallback will route to compatible quantized variant if latency breaches for 30s.
- Telemetry (PM-ready): "Runtime / Route SLOs" dashboard with: p50/p95 token-latency, request success rate (HTTP/LLM errors), and cost per 1k tokens. Optional: model-variant traffic split chart.

Jorge: quick numbers from last staging (gpu-pool-epsilon, single-token conts): 
- chat batch=8 -> p50 9ms, p95 40ms, p99 130ms
- chat batch=16 -> p50 13ms, p95 75ms, p99 270ms
- embeddings batch=128 -> p50 205ms, p95 710ms
Note: observed a transient memory bump at batch=64 on older cards; kernel watermarks mitigated.

Mina: Prewarm note — we run an opt-in prewarm using recent prompts on canary hosts which reduced p99 by ~30% for long-context routes. Prewarm is route-configurable in Console to avoid wasting cycles on cold low-traffic routes.

OpsBot: Canary created: canary/2245009999 scheduled 2026-04-12T14:00:00Z. Alerts: runtime-canary-latency, runtime-canary-memory, runtime-canary-errors.

Evan: Riya — can you paste a minimal canary config we can link in the roadmap doc? Jorge — please drop the staging dashboard link. I'll collate and push edits today.

Riya: minimal canary snippet to include in doc: 
```
canary:
  traffic_fraction: 0.05
  duration_minutes: 30
  trace_sample_rate: 1.0
  fallback_policy:
    latency_threshold_ms: 500
    consecutive_window_seconds: 30
    fallback_variant: quantized-stable
```

Jorge: staging dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/epsilon/runtime-batching-staging (histograms + memory traces).

Evan: great — thanks all. If anyone has representative prewarm prompts (short convo, long ~1500 tokens, bulk embeddings), drop them and we'll wire them into the canary job. Closing for now, will update roadmap doc and ping once done. :white_check_mark:
